title: Registration Agreement
content:
Creating an account

Create an account to use features that require one. Provide accurate account information and keep it up to date.

Protect your account credentials, including your password and verification codes. If you think someone else has accessed your account, report it promptly through the available account tools.

Account security

Choose a strong password that you do not use for other services. Do not share your password or verification codes.

Use the available security settings to help protect your account and review account activity from time to time.

Service scope

The service supports requesting and managing eligible purchases and related services. Availability may vary by product, supplier, destination and payment method.

Features may be added, changed, limited or removed when needed.

Using the service

  • Follow applicable laws and the rules that apply to the products and services you request.
  • Do not use the service to commit fraud, mislead others or interfere with the service.
  • Respect the rights of other users, sellers, carriers and rights holders.
  • Provide accurate delivery and contact details.

Orders and information

Review all details before you submit a request or payment. Keep records of your orders and check updates in your account.

If information is missing or incorrect, the service may contact you or pause the relevant request.

Ending use

You may stop using the service at any time. Access may be limited or closed if these rules are not followed or if needed to protect the service and its users.
excerpt: The basic rules for creating and using an account.
